definition: The planet that has the highest degree in any sign. It represents the soul's primary desire and lesson in the current incarnation.
A major planetary period in Vedic astrology that can last from 6 to 20 years, during which a specific planet's energy dominates the native's life.
One of the 27 lunar mansions or star constellations. They provide a much deeper psychological layer than the standard 12 zodiac signs.
The North Node of the Moon. A shadow planet representing worldly desire, obsession, and the area where the soul seeks to expand.
The South Node of the Moon. Represents past-life mastery, detachment, and spiritual liberation.
The 7.5-year period when Saturn transits over the natal Moon, its preceding sign, and its succeeding sign. Often a period of intense karmic testing.
